info.name: Get all tasks for the user.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of activities to return

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of activities to skip before collecting results

params.name: holdingIds
params.description: Filter the output for tasks related to holdings with ids in the provided argument

params.name: investingEntityIds
params.description: Filter the output for tasks related to investing entities with ids in the provided argument

params.name: issuingEntityIds
params.description: Filter the output for tasks related to issuing entities with ids in the provided argument

params.name: accountIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the account ids in the provided argument

params.name: assignedToUsers
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with an assigned user with a matching id on one of the provided ids

params.name: completedByUsers
params.description: Filter the output for tasks completed by a user with a matching id on one of the provided ids

params.name: beforeDueDate
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with a due time before the queried date-time.

params.name: afterDueDate
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with a due time after the queried date-time.

params.name: beforeCompletionDate
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with a completion date before the queried date-time.

params.name: afterCompletionDate
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with a completion date after the queried date-time.

params.name: beforeCreationTime
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with a creation time before the queried date-time.

params.name: afterCreationTime
params.description: Filter the output for tasks with a creation time after the queried date-time.

params.name: isComplete
params.description: Filter the output for tasks that have a completion status matching the provided value

params.description: Whether to include Wire Verification in the data. Please contact Arch to enable this parameter.
